svg.aria-label: What context_get returns to two tokens: a work, write token gets the header, the lines most relevant to the topic, matching skills, the work halves of the profile files, the journal's work half and search hits from work sources; a token with life scope also gets the life halves, the life profile and hits from mail and texts
